translations.web: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
translations.bsb: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
translations.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
translations.asv: Yea and if I judge, my judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
